<thought>Based on the most intense ESI‑MS peak (m/z 121.0528) the protonated ion [M+H]+ is observed. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.0455 Da. The formula that best matches this mass is C₄H₈O₄ (exact mass 120.0423 Da, within a few ppm). Therefore the molecular formula is C4H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
